Note: nothing in this report was checked by the evidence gate, so treat all of it as unverified.

For your F-250 in Sausalito you want The Cutter (Interior detail) + Upholstery and carpet shampoo add-on. No exterior.

- Your truck is Class D on their board (board lists Ford F-250 as Class D). Cutter Class D is $289, shampoo Class D is $125 = $414 base.
- Power: Cutter needs a grounded 120V outlet within 75 ft, or they run their generator for $30. Your outlet at 150 ft is beyond that, and it's a driveway (generator OK - it's only banned in enclosed/underground garages), so add $30 = $444 before travel/tax/condition.
- Travel: They are based in San Francisco and travel further for a fee - their map shows Marin / Sausalito as a travel zone, but I could not find a dollar amount for 94965 on the home page, FAQ, price-board image, area-map image, or first booking step.
- Condition: Home page and FAQ both say heavily soiled vehicles may cost extra, final price confirmed when they see the vehicle. Wall-to-wall mud + grubby seats/carpet needing shampoo fits that, so expect a possible extra decided on arrival - no fixed amount listed.
- Tax: No tax rate or tax handling found on their pages.
- When: They work Tuesday to Saturday, closed Sunday and Monday. Weekday windows Tue-Fri are Morning 8:00-9:30am and Afternoon 1:00-2:30pm. Interior-only jobs still go ahead if rain is forecast. Normal need is 24h notice; same-day ($40 fee) is Cutter-only afternoon if you call before 10am and they're free. Jobs 5h+ with add-ons must start in morning window - Cutter is listed 2-4h.
- Deposit is $50 to book, counts toward total.

So verified subtotal is $444 + travel fee (unknown) + possible heavily-soiled extra (unknown) + tax if any (unknown). Not $129 full-detail listing you may see on directories - their own site outranks that old 2023 unclaimed listing.

report.answer:
Yes — Cormorant Mobile Detailing in San Francisco can do this.

They are mobile-only ("We come to you!"), work on vans, and offer The Skiff — exterior-only wash: foam hand wash, wheels and tires, door jambs, outside glass and hand dry. "This one doesn't touch the inside."

Fit for your request:
- 3x Ford Transit full-size vans = Class D on their price board. Skiff Class D is $139 per van. 3 x $139 = $417 all-in for the wash itself, before any multi-car discount.
- Saturday: they work Tuesday to Saturday, closed Sunday/Monday. Saturday is morning arrival window only: 8:00am to 9:30am. Tue-Fri also has 1:00-2:30pm.
- At your lot: vehicle can be in driveway, private lot, open garage or legal street space with 3ft clear both sides, plus room for their work van within 100ft.
- For 3+ vehicles they need a working water spigot within 100ft — their tank only covers up to 2 vehicles. The Skiff needs no power, so no $30 generator fee.
- $50 booking deposit counts toward your total. No travel fee is listed for San Francisco — page says "We're based in San Francisco. We also travel further for a fee, see the map." 94103 SoMa is in the base zone.

Others found can't do it:
- Peninsula Suds — "Not serving San Francisco at this time"
- Sunset Shine Auto Spa — drop your car off at shop, not mobile
- Ferry Point Auto Care — partner parking garages only

To book: call/text 415-555-0142, office Mon-Sat 8am-6pm. Need 24hrs notice before window. Ask about multi-car discount when you book — homepage says "Got more than one car... Ask about discounts" but no amount is published, so $417 could drop. Also confirm if 1x $50 deposit covers all 3 vans or is per-van, and that you have a spigot available.

report.answer:
No — Cormorant Mobile Detailing does not list a multi-year ceramic coating for your Model Y.

I checked Cormorant's own site (homepage + FAQ):

- No mention of “ceramic” anywhere on the homepage. Their paint protection tops out at:
  - Schooner Full Detail with spray wax (short-term), and
  - Flagship top package with clay bar + one-step machine polish + 6-month paint sealant
- FAQ “How long does the wax last?” says: “If you want something longer we have a 6-month paint sealant, but it can only be bought together with the clay bar, on a Skiff or a Schooner. Both are already in the Flagship.” That is months, not years.

What it would run you for a Model Y in Noe Valley 94114:

- Model Y is listed as Class B on Cormorant’s price board image.
- Class B prices: Skiff (exterior wash) $79 / Cutter (interior) $179 / Schooner (full detail + spray wax) $249 / Flagship (full + clay + polish + 6-month sealant + shampoo) $629
- So the closest to ceramic — Flagship with 6-month sealant — would start at $629 for your Model Y.
- You’re in their San Francisco base zone (94114), so no travel fee is indicated — they say “We also travel further for a fee, see the map” for outside SF.
- Note: homepage says “Starting prices are for Class A… Any larger vehicle costs more. Excessive pet hair or heavily soiled vehicles may cost extra” and final price confirmed when they see the vehicle. Add-on prices for buying sealant + clay separately on a Skiff/Schooner aren’t listed in text.

Confusion to ignore: Bay Auto Pages (unclaimed listing, last updated March 2023) lists Cormorant under “ceramic coating” and “Full detail: flat $129.” Cormorant’s own site outranks that directory — its current starting full detail (Schooner) is $219 for Class A / $249 for your Class B Model Y, and it shows no ceramic offering.

If you specifically want years-long ceramic protection, Cormorant as currently listed won’t do it — you’d need a different shop. If 6-month sealant is enough, Flagship at $629 starting is the package to book.

Yes — Cormorant can come to you in 94122 for this. They're mobile-only in San Francisco.

What you need for dried vomit on back seat + floor plus smell:

- Your Honda CR-V is Class B (price board lists CR-V under Class B: sedans, crossovers, 2-row SUVs).
- Base interior package is The Cutter (interior detail: vacuum seats/carpets/mats/trunk, wipe dash/console/panels, inside glass, spot-clean). Class B $179 starting. It does NOT include shampoo.
- You need to add Upholstery and carpet shampoo: $75 for Class B. Addable to Cutter or Schooner, already included in Flagship.
- For the reek, add Odour treatment: $90 for 1-hour ozone or $140 for 2-hour ozone. Technician chooses 1hr vs 2hr after a smell test on arrival. FAQ says it's for smoke/mildew/musty — no vomit-specific wording. Can only go on a Cutter, Schooner or Flagship, not alone.

Likely totals before any extra fees:
- Cutter $179 + shampoo $75 + odour $90 = $344, or $394 with 2-hour odour
- If you also want exterior + spray wax, Schooner $249 + $75 + $90/$140 = $414 / $464

Important caveats from their site:
- No explicit vomit/biohazard price or promise. Site says "Excessive pet hair or heavily soiled vehicles may cost extra. We confirm the final price when we see your vehicle." So dried vomit will likely be treated as heavily soiled — expect possible extra, confirmed on arrival.
- Odour treatment outcome isn't guaranteed — FAQ says "Usually" for smoke smell.
- Practical needs: take out child seats/belongings/cargo before they arrive (areas still full don't get cleaned, no discount), adult to hand over keys and stay reachable. Cutter needs a grounded 120V outlet within 75ft of car or $30 generator fee, and generator can't run in enclosed/underground garage. Need driveway/private lot/open garage or legal street space with 3ft clear both sides + room for their van within 100ft. Apartment/HOA lot needs manager permission in advance.
- Hours: work Tue-Sat, closed Sun/Mon. Morning 8-9:30am, afternoon 1-2:30pm Tue-Fri, Sat morning only. Need 24hrs notice; same-day only Skiff/Cutter afternoon if free + call before 10am + $40 fee.
- Deposit $50 to book ($150 Flagship), counts to total. Cancel 48hrs+ full refund, 24-48hrs half, under 24hrs none.

I couldn't verify a travel fee for 94122 without entering your address in the booking form — site only says "Based in San Francisco. We also travel further for a fee, see map." Since you're in San Francisco, you're in their base area, but confirm no travel fee when you book at 415-555-0142.

No budget was given, so I didn't compare to a cap.

report.answer:
No — Cormorant can't do an interior clean in your underground garage as you describe it.

What you want maps to **The Cutter - Interior detail** (vacuum seats, carpets, mats and trunk, wipe dash/console/door panels, inside glass and spot-clean).

Cormorant's own FAQ says:

* The Cutter, Schooner and Flagship **need a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet of the vehicle, or we run our generator for a $30 fee.**
* **The generator can't run in an enclosed or underground garage, so without an outlet we can't do those packages in there.**

Only The Skiff (exterior wash, doesn't touch the inside) doesn't need power.

With no outlet near your space and HOA outlets locked, they cannot just bring a generator down there to get around it.

Building manager is on you:

* **You do need to get the building manager's permission for the work before you book, this goes for HOA-managed lots too.**
* **We don't contact managers, and if we get refused on the day it counts as a no-show.**

Other location rules from the same FAQ that would apply if you move the RAV4 elsewhere for the job:
Vehicle can be in a driveway, private lot, open garage or street space, as long as it stays legal for the whole job and there's at least 3 feet clear on both sides. They also need somewhere within 100 feet for their work van.

What would work: move the RAV4 to an open / above-ground spot where you have permission and either an outlet within 75 ft or open-air where they can run the generator (+$30), or find a different provider set up for enclosed garages.

To move it you must call/text 415-555-0142 - not online. Office hours Mon-Sat 8am-6pm.

Note: your job is ~6-8 hours, so it must be in the morning window 8:00-9:30am Tue-Fri, or Saturday morning only.
